notes: This is a scroll continuation of IMG_7859 - the 'As planned' message, its 3 fire reactions and the same BTC 1D BingX chart (snapshot Jul 04, 2026 00:41 UTC+4) reappear, now fully visible. All 17 coloured price-axis tags are read verbatim and their colours recorded, BUT the tags are heavily STACKED/vertically displaced by TradingView, so a tag's screen position does NOT identify which drawn line it belongs to. Only the mappings I could confirm by interpolating between the labelled 150,000.0 / 105,000.0 gridlines are asserted (82,807.9, 74,225.9, 70,985.0, 60,062.9, and the MA endpoint near 75,895.3/76,451.3); the remaining tags are recorded as 'drawn level' with no line role claimed. The arrowhead height was measured against the gridline spacing (5,000 per ~86px) and lands on the 100,000 line whose axis label is obscured by the tag stack - recorded as an interpolated reading, not a printed number. The position-tool boxes are too small to resolve individual entry/stop/target prices, so none are recorded. The 04:42 message begins with a large standalone custom emoji; 'Market confirmed ✅' is partially clipped by the '#ticket-0514' banner but is legible.
